authority.standalone_authority: fail-closed; caller-provided identity exceptions, provenance, type-chain claims, receiver identities, signatures, roots, and authenticators are not authoritative

forbidden_generated_shapes: whole-table row rewrite or key propagation
full delete and reinsert replacing row-state delta
style.field_binding: BindingField/FieldName/DataPropertyName values are explicit Designer string assignments; a col<Role>_<FIELD> field maps to FIELD.
style.tab_index: Input TabIndex values are explicit, unique, contiguous, and scoped to the supplied form.
style.db_call: Canonical wrappers use SelectType for query and parameterless CallSaveProcedure for the normal save path; direct DB parameters are uppercase @ names and procedure identities end with _SELECT/_SAVE.
style.exception_handling: CallSelectProcedure and CallSaveProcedure contain explicit try/catch handling.
style.receiver_authority: Approved inherited receiver names are accepted only when the supplied source does not declare or shadow them. Noncanonical receivers require authority outside the standalone public verifier and therefore fail closed here.
style.identity_exceptions: Unsupported by the standalone public verifier. Any supplied identity exception or caller-provided type-chain evidence produces blocked evidence and never authorizes a deviation.
style.verification_id_binding: The verification id binds exact source, Designer, and contract hashes; receipt digests; operation input and effective operations; expected and target identities; native helpers; type-chain evidence; identity exceptions; analysis mode; success; status; and issue digest.
